events.what_it_is: A temporary Fragrant Fables transformation of Aesop NoMad with a sensory fragrance installation, personalized fragrance consultations and live Fable Readings on selected dates.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the in-store fragrance experience, installation and consultations is free. Complimentary bottle engraving is tied to fragrance purchases on September 11–13 and 18–20.
events.caveats: Aesop's official store page independently confirms the NoMad address and daily 11 AM–7 PM hours. The Fragrant Fables programming and public-access details are currently documented by a current NYC event source rather than a standalone Aesop event page. Complimentary engraving requires a fragrance purchase.
events.practical_notes: Open daily September 10–20 from 11 AM–7 PM. Live Fable Readings are listed for September 11–13 and 18–20. No RSVP or approval requirement is published.

events.what_it_is: A three-day SACHEU beauty pop-up with product consultations, games and prizes, immersive installations, product discovery and a chance to meet Sarah Cheung.
events.what_is_free: The organizer advertises a free full-size product for attendees while supplies last, plus games and prizes. A separate gift-with-purchase requires a qualifying recent Ulta Beauty SACHEU purchase.
events.caveats: The organizer explicitly states that RSVP does not guarantee entry, attendance or a reserved place in line. Entry is first come, first served and subject to venue capacity; RSVP is for communications and planning. Products, gifts and promotional items are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: September 18–20 from 11 AM–5 PM at 541 W 25th Street. RSVP on Eventbrite if useful, but plan for first-come entry and capacity limits.

events.address: The Brant Foundation Gallery, 421 E 6th St, New York, NY 10009
events.what_it_is: An immersive forest of flat-pack wooden sculpture by CJ Hendry and Sulwhasoo, inspired by the hidden garden at The House of Sulwhasoo in Seoul.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the Secret Garden installation is listed as free/open to the public. No purchase requirement is stated in the verified current event sources.
events.caveats: Two current NYC event sources agree that the installation is open to the public September 18–20 from 10 AM–6 PM at The Brant Foundation Gallery. No RSVP, approval or paid-ticket requirement is published in those sources.
events.practical_notes: Friday September 18 through Sunday September 20, 10 AM–6 PM daily, at 421 E 6th Street.
